authorization: User: etymologise all Indo-Aryan SIL surveys jointly; do everything; surface tough/unclear cases for audit once done.

proposals.evidence: The complete response is ham we plus dono-type both. CDIAL 986 explicitly gives regional ham we; 6648 gives Hindi donõ both and related don/donni forms. Two ordered components preserve the response, including nasal/retroflex notation and final vowels. The source exclusive/two qualification is retained without attributing it to the old pronoun stem; local Indo-Aryan transmission remains open. Exact response: ham doṇɔ.
